description: This file contains backend API implementations for diagnostic ARP table retrieval, including functions to parse ARP cache, retrieve ARP entries, and expose ARP table data for external use within the COSA Data Model framework.

methods.name: s_parse_arp_cache
methods.description: Parses a line from ARP cache output to fill arpHost_t structure.

methods.name: _GetARPCacheEntries
methods.description: Retrieves ARP cache entries by executing system command and parsing output.

methods.name: CosaDmlDiagGetARPTablePriv
methods.description: Provides the complete ARP table as a dynamically allocated array for external modules.
